mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates aggressive monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals labor market distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 12-month moving averages indicate contracting consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 relative to prior quarter indicates weakening supply capacity, reducing corporate output and earnings growth expectations for negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1,400 units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through reduced construction sector activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below prior month values indicates broad consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% monthly signals labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which produces positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns in accommodative monetary conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly over any 2-year rolling window.
